**Management Summary – Project LV 197,968 €**

The audit identified numerous high‑risk duplicate and under‑specified items that could lead to double payments or non‑compliance. Duplicate positions total ≈ €40 k (e.g., 2.1.4.50 vs 2.1.1.10, 2.1.4.90 vs 2.1.1.50, etc.) and must be consolidated. Critical specification gaps affect thermal insulation, frost protection, and waterproofing, exposing the project to STLB‑Bau, VOB, and GEG compliance failures (≈ €4 k). Unit mismatches in concrete work (m² vs m³) risk calculation errors (€1 k). Immediate actions: (1) eliminate duplicated line items, (2) enrich technical descriptions to meet statutory standards, (3) correct unit definitions, and (4) re‑run the cost estimate. Expected savings and risk reduction: €45 k‑€50 k.
